message.content: Mark Rendon (Green) runs on a platform that explicitly calls for divesting state funds from corporations "complicit in genocide," adopting BDS standards for state expenditures, and repealing California laws prohibiting educators from teaching about the genocide in Palestine. Vote for Peace, a candidate rating guide evaluating human rights and war-lobby funding, lists Rendon as "supported" in the general phase with an "Ally" tier. The Green Party of California made $7,000 in independent spending supporting Rendon, with relevance to Palestine unestablished. No Israel-aligned endorsements or contrary Palestine-stance records appear in his file. In contrast, Buffy Wicks (Democrat) stated on October 10, 2023 that she "stands with the Israeli people" and called the October 7 violence "terrorism, plain and simple." She voted Aye on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. Wicks received a primary endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, carried forward for the general, and support from California Jewish Democrats rated "Support." Her independent spending includes $265,230 from Uber Innovation PAC, with unestablished relevance to Palestine.
